'''Elke''' was the seventh [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Iminec]] in the [[Kalee system/Legends|Kalee system]]. Located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], it was a [[Water/Legends|frozen]] rock.
